theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_diag_blowup_variation_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t R : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → 0 < t → 0 < R → (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R, ξ + t • y ∈ U) → ∃ W : Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R), W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∧ W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation ∧ variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n * t) * variationMeasure V (closedBall ξ (t * R))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
